title: KCET 2026 Examination
description: The Karnataka Common Entrance Test (KCET), commonly known as UGCET, is a state-level entrance exam for admission to undergraduate courses in engineering, pharmacy, agriculture, and other professional fields in Karnataka. Conducted by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), it is a pen-and-paper, multiple-choice question exam held in April/May for government and private colleges.
